checks.rationale: AC1 cannot represent actual exhausted budgets for recovery (R1-TASK-039-001). AC2 passes: exact injected execution/completion interfaces and distinct statuses.
Interface-only scope, frozen v1 fields and exclusions are respected, but REQ-06/AC-06 retained cumulative recovery usage is blocked by R1-TASK-039-001.
Graph/task, lease/provider and exact-candidate gate inputs trace correctly. LineageBudget rejects legitimate actual observations before RecoveryRequest reaches the service.

Unknown/ambiguous outputs and cancellation remain explicit and fenced. Above-limit exhaustion becomes a construction error instead of recoverable facts for a durable budget pause; no resource-owning implementation is present.

Missing evidence, incomplete context, stale leases, scope overlap and unauthorized/unobserved completion are guarded. Four above-limit elapsed/token/cumulative review cases fail required observation representation.
All 19 declared tests pass and exercise meaningful contracts; none tests LineageBudget at or beyond a limit. Independent equality and four over-limit probes expose R1-TASK-039-001.
Exactly one pure port module, dedicated tests and handoff; no later concrete algorithms, IO, adapters, wiring or central registry.
Reconstructed exact base/head diff contains only the three declared additions, with no unrelated or prohibited-path edits, renames or deletions.
Frozen typed values, detached collections and shared errors provide explicit boundaries. All ten Protocol method types are exact; four schema-backed records preserve their v1 property sets.

No IO or permission expansion; request/lease/attempt/provider fences precede imports, unknown cancellation cannot release scope, and completed requires observed authorized merge. Source/schema boundaries remain intact.

The task-local handoff accurately records scope, dependency reuse, actual commands, native provenance and interface-only limits; update its budget explanation when correcting finding 001. Shared documents remain unchanged.

findings.description: LineageBudget rejects actual usage above configured limits at src/orchestration_ports.py:1250-1261. A run resumed at elapsed_seconds=3601 with max_elapsed_seconds=3600, or an observed operation using 10001 tokens against a 10000-token limit, raises ValueError before RecoveryRequest can carry the actual counters to recovery for a durable budget_exhausted pause. Cumulative R1/R2 history count 3 is also rejected against the default two-cycle recovery trigger. This conflates policy thresholds with representability of observed facts; clamping/resetting would discard required lineage usage.
findings.expected_fix: Preserve nonnegative integer validation but allow actual equal-limit and over-limit cumulative observations unchanged in LineageBudget/RecoveryRequest. Leave the pause or bounded-repair policy decision to the later recovery service; do not use the two-cycle trigger as a ceiling on retained historical counters. Add below/equal/above-limit elapsed, token and cumulative-review regressions and update the handoff. No wire-schema or concrete recovery-algorithm change is required.
